activation_required.name: activation_required
activation_required.description: Activate this device before using Decision Engine tools.

audit_skill_submit.name: audit_skill_submit
audit_skill_submit.description: Start an advisory-only DE Lite local defect review in the current interactive agent session. This does not contact Decision Engine Hub.

audit_skill_complete.name: audit_skill_complete
audit_skill_complete.description: Finish the current DE Lite local advisory. This updates only the local stopper state, does not contact Decision Engine Hub, and never closes an audit gate.

service_unavailable.name: service_unavailable
service_unavailable.description: The Decision Engine Hub is unreachable. Reconnect and retry.

display_schemas.name: open_ge_popup
display_schemas.description: Open the server-rendered graphic-explanation artifact (by run_id) in a native popup on the user's machine. Returns {status, popup_id}. The image bytes are fetched client-side and never returned to you — do not inline.

context.description: Conversation context for the in-popup follow-up chat (optional; slice ③).

display_schemas.name: open_ge
display_schemas.description: Open a server-rendered graphic-explanation in a native popup in ONE call: for comic, infographic, or diagram, this tool submits the render, waits for it, fetches the finished artifact client-side, and opens the popup — you do NOT poll or call open_ge_popup. Returns {status, popup_id} when opened; the artifact bytes are never returned to you — do not inline. This call waits up to 10 minutes for a terminal server status. Only if the run is still pending after that ceiling does it return {status:'scheduled', run_id} and continue in a bounded best-effort worker. If submission outcome is unknown, it returns {status:'request_outcome_unknown', retryable:true, client_request_id}; retry only with that exact client_request_id. After submission, any failed result includes run_id for diagnosis and recovery.

mode.description: The server render mode; every mode uses the one-call open_ge flow.

spec.description: The user-content spec for the mode — see the visual_render tool's inputSchema.

client_request_id.description: Optional DE idempotency key; surrounding whitespace is removed before first use. After an uncertain submit, reuse the exact normalized value returned by the response.

context.description: Conversation context for the in-popup follow-up chat (optional).

display_schemas.name: open_db_board
display_schemas.description: Open a discussion board (user-content spec) as an interactive native popup for hand-editing. Returns {status, popup_id}; poll db_board_result for the edited board.

spec.description: The board spec (columns/notes/etc.) — user content only.

display_schemas.name: db_board_result
display_schemas.description: Bounded poll (≤55s) for a discussion-board popup's outcome. Returns {status:'open'} (poll again), {status:'done', board} (the user's edits), {status:'dismissed'}, or {status:'unknown'}. The board stays retrievable by popup_id until it expires.
